children: Jefferies sees a low likelihood of Goodman announcing incremental leasing progress for its data-center pipeline on Wednesday. "It would likely be taken positively if Goodman can announce heads of agreement have been executed at the 50MW LAX01 project," analyst Andrew Dodds says. In August, Goodman said it was in 'advanced negotiations' with heads of terms under negotiation with a hyperscale customer. "Similarly, if Goodman can convert leasing negotiations at HK10 and AMS01 as flagged in August, the market will likely view the improvement in conversion velocity as a positive for de-risking the remainder of the WIP pipeline." Jefferies also expects Goodman will reiterate guidance for operating EPS growth of 9% in FY27. It retains a buy call and A$30.35/share price target on Goodman, which ended last week at A$27.00. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
